posts.title: Darkadia has closed
posts.description: As of 5 February 2026, Darkadia has now permanently closed. Thank you to everyone who used the site over the years. When I sent the closure announcement, I was genuinely taken aback by the number of messages I received from you. posts.title: Darkadia is closing down 😢
posts.description: Giant Bomb has recently separated from Fandom, and unfortunately the API that Darkadia relies on has been shut down. Without access to Giant Bomb’s game data, there’s no way to keep the site running. I wanted to give you time to export your collection before I switch things off. You can download your data as a CSV file from your account settings, under Extras. The site will close on 5 February 202

posts.title: A new life
posts.description: As of today, Darkadia is running on upgraded software on an upgraded server. I’ve been hard at work over the last few weeks getting everything prepped for the transfer, which required quite a lot of under-the-hood tinkering.
